name: game-event
description: Project commands for the agent, hooks, CI and humans. See the table in CLAUDE.md.

scripts.setup: npm install && npm --prefix web install && npm --prefix e2e install && dotnet tool restore && dotnet restore GameEvent.slnx
scripts.lint: dotnet format GameEvent.slnx --verify-no-changes && npm --prefix web run -s lint && npm --prefix e2e run -s lint && prettier --check .
scripts.build: dotnet build GameEvent.slnx -nologo && npm --prefix web run -s build
scripts.test:fast: npm run -s test:dotnet:fast && npm --prefix web run -s test
scripts.test: npm run -s test:dotnet && npm --prefix web run -s test
scripts.test:mutation: dotnet tool run dotnet-stryker --config-file stryker-config.json --output test-artifacts/stryker
